reports.title: Central Statistical Organization (CSO) institutional core
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics. Publishes the Statistical Yearbook and participates in the IMF enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS).
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Myanmar statistical system. Data continuity and coverage are constrained relative to many peers.
reports._cadence_evidence: CSO site advertises the Myanmar Statistical Yearbook as its flagship, latest edition 2025, one per year. The site also lists Selected Monthly Economic Indicators (monthly) and a Quarterly Statistics Bulletin, but the newest SMEI shown is January 2021 and the newest quarterly bulletin is 2022-2023, so only the annual yearbook is still current; 1 reflects the yearbook.

reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population is approximately 55 million; the age structure remains relatively young.
reports._url_evidence: MMSIS (Central Statistical Organization) 'Census Reports' page listing the 2014 Myanmar Population and Housing Census volumes (Union Report Vol 2-B/2-C, thematic reports on mortality, gender, disability, older population) and the 2014-2050 population projections report.
reports._cadence_evidence: MMSIS population file list shows only 2014 census thematic outputs (e.g. thematic report on population projections 2014-2050), all with the same entry date of 2018-03-22. No periodicity is stated and there is no second census cycle on the page to count from.

reports.title: National Accounts of Myanmar (GDP)
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP). Central macro-output series for an economy heavily shaped by agriculture, extractives, informal activity and political-institutional constraints.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. Interpretation requires care given data gaps and informal activity.
reports._url_evidence: MMSIS 'National income' indicator page for Gross Domestic Product (At Current Producers' Prices), showing a 2012-2023 series in Kyat million (125,338,951.9 for 2022) broken into agriculture, industry and services.
reports._cadence_evidence: MMSIS GDP indicator is a single annual series (GDP at current producers' prices by sector) with one observation per year from 2012 to 2023; no sub-annual periods and no stated update frequency. Series is effectively dormant - it ends at 2023 with no later period posted.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been elevated and volatile in recent years under exchange-rate pressures and supply disruptions.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency price node under elevated-inflation conditions.
reports._url_evidence: MMSIS/CSO 'Inflation Reports' series page listing monthly inflation report PDFs; note the series visibly stops at December 2020, so it is a dormant post-coup product page rather than a current one.
reports._cadence_evidence: MMSIS CPI file list is a run of monthly 'Inflation Report (Month Year)' items - March 2020 through December 2020 on the first page, with further pages of earlier months. Series is dormant: the newest edition is December 2020, so nothing has been posted for five years, but the cadence while running was monthly.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Current-account dynamics, limited FDI, and large errors and omissions reflecting informal and unrecorded cross-border activity are recurring features.
reports._notes: External-accounts node under constrained data and institutional conditions.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved and read: Myanmar Statistical Yearbook 2024, Part 3 (Central Statistical Organization). It contains Chapter 13 'Foreign Trade and Investment', whose Table 13.15 is 'Balance of Payments' for FY2019/2020 to FY2023/2024, with current-account items (exports f.o.b., imports f.o.b., trade balance, services, primary income, secondary income) and financial-account components. This is an official national BOP presentation, obtained after the NSDP's designated URL (cbm.gov.mm/content/3905) again failed - cbm.gov.mm returns HTTP 503 on robots.txt for both www and bare hostnames.
reports._url_route: successor publisher - CSO publications index (csostat.gov.mm) after the NSDP-designated CBM page stayed unreachable
reports._cadence_evidence: The linked file is Myanmar Statistical Yearbook 2024 Part 3 (foreign trade and investment chapter); the yearbook is an annual CSO volume and its methodology sheets give dissemination frequency as 'Yearly' for these tables.

reports.title: Agriculture production statistics
reports.description: Official and compiled statistics on crop and livestock production. Agriculture remains a large share of employment and rural livelihoods; rice is the dominant staple and a material export crop.
reports._notes: Core primary-sector production node. Data coverage is incomplete relative to pre-2021 benchmarks.
reports._url_evidence: MMSIS/CSO 'General Reports' page whose listing is dominated by the Myanmar Agricultural Statistics series, most recent edition covering 2016-2017 to 2024-2025.
reports._cadence_evidence: MMSIS lists successive editions of Myanmar Agricultural Statistics, each covering a rolling set of fiscal years - 2012-13 to 2020-21 (entered 2023-01-03), 2013-14 to 2021-22 (2023-04-28), 2014-15 to 2022-23 (2024-03-22), and two newer volumes entered 2026-06-19. Roughly one new edition per year; no explicit frequency statement.

reports.title: Exchange-rate regime and parallel-market statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Myanmar / parallel-market trackers
reports.description: Official and parallel-market exchange rates for the kyat. Multiple rates and a persistent parallel-market premium are structural features under currency controls, limited FX availability and elevated inflation.
reports._notes: Critical price and external-constraint node. Parallel-market premium is a key signal.
reports._url_evidence: MMSIS 'Foreign Exchange Rates' indicator page showing the official monthly kyat rate against USD and EUR from Aug 2021 to Jul 2022 (1,684-1,850 kyat/USD). Official rate only - the parallel-market side of this item is not covered, and the CBM's own FX pages are unreachable via WebFetch.
reports._cadence_evidence: MMSIS foreign exchange rate indicator is a monthly series (kyat per USD and EUR) with one observation per month from 2021.08 to 2022.07. Series is dormant - the last period posted is July 2022 - but its cadence while running was monthly.
